blocks.title: Software development
blocks.text: Software development is the process of creating computer programs designed to perform specific tasks. It involves writing code, testing it and addressing any issues that arise.

Software development is important because it helps solve problems and makes our lives easier. For example, software allows us to communicate with friends through social media, helps us manage our money with banking apps, and makes learning fun with educational games.

blocks.prompt: Give two everyday examples showing why software development is important.
blocks.explanation: Any two of: social media apps let us talk to friends; banking apps help us manage money; educational games make learning enjoyable.

items: Software development: creating programs for specific tasks by writing code, testing it and fixing issues.
It matters because software solves problems: social media, banking apps, educational games.
